summary: At segment 0 step 97, self-knowledge from a fountain displays the wrong blindness cause. C says the hero is deliberately blind because of the worn blindfold; JavaScript reports temporarily blind. The source mismatch is the Blindfolded_only predicate in insight.c:status_enlightenment, not the water-snake fountain outcome named by the case.

source.branch: In status_enlightenment, when Blind is true and HBlinded has no FROMOUTSIDE/FROMFORM cause, C selects "deliberately" exactly when EBlinded is set and Blinded is false. youprop.h:92-103 defines Blinded from intrinsic blindness only and Blind from intrinsic or extrinsic blindness, both respecting BBlinded. The JS predicate instead tested E(BLINDED) && !blind where blind includes the extrinsic blindfold, making Blindfolded_only false.
callers: fountain.c:drinkfountain fate 19 -> insight.c:enlightenment -> insight.c:status_enlightenment; JavaScript fountain.js:drinkfountain imports insight.js:enlightenment, which calls status_enlightenment.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/accepted-26748832bec4c8d55150cd96f4f870355f5d2bbd-v53.json at 26748832bec4c8d55150cd96f4f870355f5d2bbd reports this case at 202/203 screens, 2985/2985 RNG values, and 203/203 cursors; the manifest sourceTrace identifies the first mismatch at step 97.

The immutable recording segment 0 step 96 drinks the fountain and receives fate 19 self-knowledge; step 97 opens the attributes menu, with C text "You are deliberately blind because of your blindfold." The recording records no RNG delta at step 97 and a matching cursor; the only discrepancy is that status line.

Upstream insight.c:1060-1071 selects the adjective using Blindfolded_only; youprop.h:92-103 defines Blindfolded_only as EBlinded && !Blinded, while Blind includes both HBlinded and EBlinded. js/insight.js:1208-1210 incorrectly used !blind where blind includes the extrinsic blindfold; js/insight.js:1314-1316 consumes that value for the status phrase.

The displayed title and status menu are reached through the active source caller fountain.c:drinkfountain:286-290 -> insight.c:enlightenment:383-422 -> status_enlightenment. JavaScript fountain.js:693-705 wires the same fate to insight.js:enlightenment, whose body calls status_enlightenment at 2047.

firstMismatch.cScreenMessage: You are deliberately blind because of your blindfold.
firstMismatch.jsBehavior: You are temporarily blind because of your blindfold.

mismatch.message: The C Blindfolded_only macro tests extrinsic blindfold blindness against Blinded (intrinsic blindness); JavaScript excluded the active blindfold from its own adjective predicate.
